Population grid for Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly

Source: R/data_cornwall.R
cornwall_pop.Rd

A WorldPop 2020 population grid (UN-adjusted) clipped to Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly. The GeoTIFF is bundled in inst/extdata and is not a lazy-loaded object; load it with read_spax_example("cornwall_pop.tif").

Format

A one-layer GeoTIFF (pop): 132 rows x 271 columns of 30 arc-second cells (about 1 km; about 0.55 square km at this latitude), EPSG:4326. Values are estimated residents per cell. Cells crossing the boundary are weighted by the share of their area inside it; NA marks cells outside. The total (about 543,000) is about 7% below the ONS mid-2024 estimate used in cornwall_lsoa (585,655); do not mix the two unknowingly.

Source

WorldPop (2018), Global High Resolution Population Denominators Project, 2020 UN-adjusted 1 km estimates for the United Kingdom, doi:10.5258/SOTON/WP00671 , Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. See system.file("COPYRIGHTS", package = "spax").

See also

cornwall_gp_travel

Examples

pop <- read_spax_example("cornwall_pop.tif")
terra::global(pop, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
#>        sum
#> pop 542666
